posts.name: EPenna
posts.cooked:
So, I just bought SotM, and I have a couple of rules questions:

 

- When an end-of-phase effect puts into play a card that has on it an end-of-phase effect, does the card's effect activate in that end-of-phase, or only the next one?

 

- In his Transhuman Serial Killer side, Spite regains HP for equal to the damage he inflicts. Is this before or after taking into account damage reduction effects? Frex, Spite does to damage to Haka, who has a card reducing all damage done to him by 1, meaning he takes only 2 damage from Spite's attack.. Does Spite regain 3 HP or 2 HP?

 

- Similar questions regarding Fanatic's Zealous Offense card: the card goes away if she doesn't inflict at least 3 damage per turn. Is that before or after taking damage reduction effects into account?

posts.name: Reckless
posts.cooked:
1.  That end-of-turn.  Same for start-of-turn cards that are played during the start-of-turn.

2.  2 HP.

3.  After taking DR effects into account.
